title: The Book by the Brook
lines: Ben took a good book to the brook.
He stood on a log made of wood.
A duck came to look at his book.
The wet log shook, and the book fell in!
Ben got a long stick with a hook.
He took the damp book home to dry.
Next time Ben will look for a dry log.

questions.ask: Where did Ben stand to read his book?
questions.listenFor: On a log made of wood, by the brook. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: How did Ben get his book back?
questions.listenFor: With a long stick that had a hook on it.

questions.ask: What do you think the duck wanted? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine if it comes from the story - listen for a reason.
